name: Onna Kyoushi
source:
This games focuses on Yuichiro, a formerly good-natured student who has turned twisted since being falsely accused of rape at a previous school. At his new school, he encounters a group of perverted, abusive bullies, some of their victims, and any number of extremely attractive and libidinous young instructors.

[Edited from AniDB]
translation:
这款游戏的主角是优一郎，他是一名原本善良的学生，自从在以前的学校被诬告强奸后变得扭曲。在他的新学校，他遇到了一群变态、虐待的恶霸、他们的一些受害者，以及许多极具吸引力和性欲的年轻教师。
